participation.context: Stood at the fire, named the watch doubled, and did not tell Kemp the king.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Stayed twenty minutes and took Alse in.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Came in with her, and did not measure the neighbours' bread.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Stayed at the door of the close.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

participation.context: Walked you home, and pointed out the boy.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Tapped the bells' rhythm on the doorpost.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

relations.quote: I have stood here twenty minutes, and twenty minutes is my measure.

story.body: You stood in Bishopsgate with the house and with the two who had walked you home. Nobody leapt the fire. You did not tell Kemp what the king is.

relations.quote: I have stood here twenty minutes, and twenty minutes is my measure.

title: Stood at the parish fire in Bishopsgate

participation.context: Looked at the bonfire, and was not himself in the picture.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You stood where the faces were lit from below, and the cressets passed behind them.

title: Looked at the fire from the street
